capabilities: Merge per-device reading position records using the latest reading timestamp
Hook into Remotely Save runs to export positions before sync and verify and merge after
Resolve equal-timestamp conflicts manually and skip malformed or future-dated records
Back up the local position database before importing remote progress
Restore the merged position on demand or jump to it after syncing
disambiguation: Not a vault sync plugin; it makes no network requests itself and relies on Remotely Save to transfer its progress records.
extras: Settings and notices currently use Simplified Chinese only. Desktop-only; PDF and mobile are not supported. Wraps non-public runtime methods of both dependencies, so their updates may require compatibility fixes. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Sync Markdown reading positions across multiple computers by connecting Remember cursor position and Remotely Save.
problem: Remember Cursor Position stores reading positions only in each computer's local vault, so progress does not follow you when you switch devices.

relations.evidence: Remember cursor position records and restores positions

requires.name: Remote storage service configured in Remotely Save
Remote storage service may require payment

summary: Bridge that syncs Markdown reading positions across computers by merging Remember Cursor Position records through Remotely Save.
